Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the recorded daily maximum temperature at London Heathrow Airport (EGLL) exceeds 20°C strictly after 2026-10-01T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z.
- "No": Wins if the recorded daily maximum temperature at London Heathrow Airport (EGLL) does not exceed 20°C over that same interval.

Clarifications:
- The measurement window is strictly after 2026-10-01T23:00:00Z and at or before 2026-10-02T23:00:00Z; the relevant figure is the highest recorded hourly or daily-maximum temperature observation at EGLL within this window. "Tops 20°C" means any reading strictly greater than 20.0°C.
